messages:
nick_cs: Quick heads-up — Borealis onboarding: p95 latency climbed ~1.9x after the model rename. AE flagged renewal as 'watch'. Need a short, customer-safe set of perf options to propose before the account call.

anya_platform: Do we have traffic shape? mostly short QA or long summaries?

nick_cs: Mostly short Q&A (60-400 tokens) with occasional batch analytic jobs. Link to traffic slice: https://rwd.io/insight/borealis-slice.

dave_ml: Fast wins: 1) route <=500 token FAQ traffic to rw-compact-v3-int8, 2) enable prefix KV caching for the system prompt, 3) for analytics, move to an async pipeline using rw-analytic-lite with batching.

sam_sre: Agree. Also check if the recent model change increased top-k sampling leading to more tokens. If so, revert sampling or cap max_tokens for FAQ route.

nick_cs: Customer is very sensitive to answer exactness on KB answers  can't risk hallucinations.

dave_ml: We'll run a quick 120-case KB eval (recall/exact-match) on compact-int8 vs baseline. If pass thresholds, safe to route. Estimated cost savings for routed slice ~35-50%. Latency p95 should drop ~25-40ms.

anya_platform: I can add a token-aware routing rule in Console. Sample snippet for ops playbook (we'll paste as code for CS):
```json
{
  "route":"account:borealis",
  "rules":[
    {"if":"prompt_tokens <= 500","model":"rw-compact-v3-int8"},
    {"if":"intent == \"analytics\"","model":"rw-analytic-lite","mode":"async"},
    {"else":"rw-large-v2-quant"}
  ],
  "fallback":"rw-large-v2"
}
```
(rollback: immediate fallback to rw-large-v2).

sam_sre: I'll set a 5% canary for the rule and enable a circuit-breaker: if regen-error-rate > 0.5% or p95 increases, revert.

route-bot: route-bot: Canary scheduled for account:borealis canary_id=canary-7377777777 at 7377777795 (pct=5). Monitoring: p50/p95/p99, token-delta, regen-error-rate.

nick_cs: I'll ask Borealis for a 90-minute window tomorrow and request they run 30 sample KB queries during the canary for manual checks.

dave_ml: Also suggest enabling continuous KV caching for repeated system prompts and lowering batch_size to 6 on dedicated pools during the canary.

anya_platform: Action items: 1) Dave run KB eval and share thresholds (ETA 24h). 2) Sam schedule 5% canary and post metrics (ETA after canary). 3) Nick coordinate customer sample window and capture feedback.

nick_cs: Perfect. I'll update the renewal-risk note and loop AE + PM. Thanks team :thumbsup:
